candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Slightly closer oncoming/autopilot vehicle ahead of ego near signalized intersection, preserving late-run on-route collision under active non-green traffic lights.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Tighten spatial interaction between ego and the primary vehicle actor while keeping overall route, traffic lights, and environment similar, so that the ego remains in motion with adequate perception/planning signals but still collides near the end of the run without clear braking, matching the unresolved-module root-cause pattern.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Ensure mission route still passes through at least one signalized intersection with active traffic_lights messages.
Verify that all mutated actors (indices 0,1,2) spawn successfully on valid lanes or walkable areas and remain within map drivable bounds.
Check that overall scenario duration and route length are sufficient for a late-run interaction between ego and actor_index 0.
Confirm that moderate rain/fog/wetness adjustments do not disable or drastically degrade perception topics (detection, prediction).
post_execution_validation_rules: Check oracle summary for a collision involving the ego near the end of the run; discard runs without a late-run collision.
Confirm traffic_lights topic exists and includes at least one red or non-green state in the time window leading up to the collision.
Verify ego has nonzero forward speed (using vehicle_status or odometry) immediately before impact; filter out cases where ego is fully stopped prior to collision.
Ensure detection and prediction topics report at least one nearby object during the pre-collision window, and planning final_waypoints remain populated and continuous up to the collision.
Do not require lane_invasion or a confirmed red-light stop-line crossing; treat such labels as non-essential for same-root-cause.

Check that braking commands in vehicle_cmd or effective deceleration in vehicle_status remain weak or delayed relative to the time of impact, consistent with minimal or no timely braking before collision.
uncertainty: Exact spatial relation between ego path and traffic light stop line remains unconstrained; red-light violation may or may not be reported.
Responsibility among perception, planning, actuation, or simulator for the lack of timely braking is not identifiable from runtime logs alone.
Lane_invasion labels, if present, may disagree between dataset and error.json and should not be relied on for root-cause matching.

note: Generated candidate scenario JSON for local DriveFuzz execution. It has not been executed in CARLA/Autoware.
